mostWorthwhile.text: Placing the young grove in the world was most worthwhile: the resulting forest ties future growth to the lives that will feed on fallen wood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Scattering the seeds was straightforward but felt thin, with no detail about how dispersal happened.

surprise.text: The seeds became a young grove as soon as they met soil; the transition was quicker than I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, though the only available combination at each step left little room for meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what happens beyond the horizon, but only if another chapter offered more meaningful choices; this ending works well as a conclusion.
